dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Maps Schedule 9 Brampton Bedrock information on the thickness of material deposits above the bedrock surface.

Bedrock Aggregate Resource Deposits Overburden Thickness identifies areas containing bedrock aggregate resources and indicates the depth of soil, sediment, or other material overlying the deposit. This information helps evaluate resource potential and informs long-term planning and resource management decisions related to aggregate extraction.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
